systems.system: Centralised civil-status database / unified information system
systems.owner: Direction générale des collectivités territoriales (DGCT), Ministère de l'Intérieur
systems.tiers: 1,821 civil-status offices in ten regions; an international tender of 194 million dirhams in five lots (bids due 29 May 2025) to digitise more than 38 million acts, with the stated aim of linking every civil-status office to one system

note: A tender to digitise civil-status records, an application; linking the 1,821 civil-status offices to a unified system is given as the project's aim (April 2025), not as something in place, and no office connection is stated.
